Responsabile marketing

Morgan Hill, CA 95037
Tempo pieno | Exempt | Remote

Fare un impatto su Tecan

Sei appassionato di sviluppare iniziative strategiche di marketing che spingono la consapevolezza del marchio, generano la domanda e supportano la crescita commerciale? Unisciti a Tecan come Marketing Manager, dove potrai svolgere un ruolo chiave nel posizionare l'offerta CDMO di Tecan, attraverso campagne di marketing integrate, leadership di pensiero e stretta collaborazione con team commerciali globali.

In questo ruolo, sarai il partner di marketing tra Product Management, Sales, Business Development, Regional Commercial Teams, Brand e Internal Communications per rafforzare il coinvolgimento dei clienti, ottimizzare l'imbuto di vendita e fornire risultati aziendali misurabili.

Se sei un marketer strategico e guidato dai dati che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce e gode di importanti iniziative interfunzionali, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Come farai ad avere un impatto?

• Sviluppare ed eseguire piani strategici di marketing per l'offerta di Tecan Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations.

• Creare quadri di messaggistica, proposizioni di valore e posizionamento di mercato allineati con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Progettazione e realizzazione di campagne di marketing integrate, tra cui Account-Based Marketing (ABM).

• Sviluppare programmi di marketing multicanale e contenuti che animano la consapevolezza, l'impegno, la generazione della domanda e la crescita commerciale.

• Produrre contenuti di leadership pensiero e comunicazioni esecutive per rafforzare la visibilità del settore.

• Raccogliere clienti, competitivi e approfondimenti di mercato per informare la strategia di marketing.

• Gestire i budget di marketing assegnati e massimizzare il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Misura le prestazioni della campagna, la qualità del piombo, le metriche di conversione e il ROI di marketing utilizzando l'analisi data-driven.

• Sostenere le squadre commerciali regionali con iniziative di marketing e l'esecuzione delle campagne.

• Sviluppare materiali di attivazione delle vendite, tra cui presentazioni, brochure, studi di casi, strumenti di campagna e attività digitali.

• Guidare e sostenere eventi globali, eventi clienti, webinar e conferenze del settore.

• Mantenere la libreria di presentazione di Partnering Business e coordinare gli aggiornamenti con Product Manager.

• Collabora con brand, comunicazioni interne, marketing LSB, vendite, sviluppo aziendale e team regionali globali per garantire messaggistica ed esecuzione coerenti.

• Miglioramento continuo dell'efficacia del marketing attraverso la collaborazione interfunzionale.

Che cosa porta

• Forte strategia di marketing B2B e esperienza di esecuzione.

• Competenza in campagne di marketing integrate e Marketing basato su Account.

• Forte capacità di storytelling, messaggistica e sviluppo dei contenuti.

• Esperienza con la generazione della domanda e la gestione del ciclo di vita principale.

• Forte mentalità analitica con esperienza di misurazione delle prestazioni di marketing e ROI.

• Eccellente gestione degli stakeholder e competenze di collaborazione interfunzionali.

• Esperienza gestione budget di marketing e relazioni di agenzia.

• Capacità di dare priorità a più iniziative in un ambiente frenetico.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e project management.

• mentalità orientata al cliente con forte acume aziendale.

• Automotivata con un approccio pratico e un forte senso di proprietà.

• Adattabilità e miglioramento continuo.

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea o Master in Marketing, Business Administration, o campo relativo.

• 5-7 anni di esperienza di marketing B2B.

• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di organizzazioni multinazionali.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di strategie e campagne di marketing integrate.

• Esperienza con canali di marketing digitali tra cui SEO, SEM, email marketing e social media.

• Proficienza con piattaforme di automazione di marketing come HubSpot.

• Esperienza con Microsoft 365 (Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).

• Esperienza con i sistemi di gestione dei contenuti del sito web (CMS).

• Esperienza di scrittura tecnica.

• Esperienza di analisi delle prestazioni di marketing utilizzando dashboard e strumenti di reporting.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione inglese.

Bello da avere

• Esperienza all'interno di Scienze della Vita, Diagnostica, Biotecnologia o Tecnologia Medica.

• Esperienza che supporta le organizzazioni OEM/CDMO.

• Formazione o certificazione in Account-Based Marketing, Branding, o Project Management.

• AI per esperienza di marketing.

• Competenze di Marketing Analytics.

• Esperienza con piattaforme CRM come Salesforce o SAP C4C.

• Familiarità con strumenti di creazione di contenuti assistiti da AI.

• Esperienza di mappatura del viaggio del cliente.

• Ulteriori competenze linguistiche come il tedesco.

• Esperienza creativa di pensiero e innovazione.

Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di viaggiare circa il 20%.

Gamma di insalata: $100K– $125K
(Salario da determinare per l'istruzione, l'esperienza, la conoscenza, le competenze e le capacità del richiedente, l'equità interna e l'allineamento con i dati del settore.)

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - fiducia, elevati standard e ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

Marketing Manager

Morgan Hill, CA 95037
Full-Time | Exempt | Remote

Make an Impact at Tecan

Are you passionate about developing strategic marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, generate demand, and support commercial growth? Join Tecan as a Marketing Manager, where you'll play a key role in positioning Tecan's CDMO offering, through integrated marketing campaigns, thought leadership, and close collaboration with global commercial teams.

In this role, you'll serve as the marketing partner between Product Management, Sales, Business Development, Regional Commercial Teams, Brand, and Internal Communications to strengthen customer engagement, optimize the sales funnel, and deliver measurable business results.

If you're a strategic, data-driven marketer who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and enjoys leading cross-functional initiatives, we'd love to hear from you.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Develop and execute strategic marketing plans for Tecan's Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations offering.

• Create messaging frameworks, value propositions, and market positioning aligned with business objectives.

• Design and implement integrated marketing campaigns, including Account-Based Marketing (ABM).

• Develop multi-channel marketing programs and content that drive awareness, engagement, demand generation, and commercial growth.

• Produce thought leadership content and executive communications to strengthen industry visibility.

• Gather customer, competitive, and market insights to inform marketing strategy.

• Manage assigned marketing budgets and maximize return on investment.

• Measure campaign performance, lead quality, conversion metrics, and marketing ROI using data-driven analysis.

• Support regional commercial teams with marketing initiatives and campaign execution.

• Develop sales enablement materials including presentations, brochures, case studies, campaign toolkits, and digital assets.

• Lead and support global events, customer events, webinars, and industry conferences.

• Maintain the Partnering Business presentation library and coordinate updates with Product Managers.

• Collaborate with Brand, Internal Communications, LSB Marketing, Sales, Business Development, and Global Regional Teams to ensure consistent messaging and execution.

• Drive continuous improvement of marketing effectiveness through cross-functional collaboration.

What You Bring

• Strong B2B marketing strategy and execution experience.

• Expertise in integrated marketing campaigns and Account-Based Marketing.

• Strong storytelling, messaging, and content development skills.

• Experience with demand generation and lead lifecycle management.

• Strong analytical mindset with experience measuring marketing performance and ROI.

• Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Experience managing marketing budgets and agency relationships.

• Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, and project management skills.

• Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen.

• Self-motivated with a hands-on approach and strong sense of ownership.

• Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset.

Your Background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.

• 5–7 years of B2B marketing experience.

• Experience working within multinational organizations.

• Experience developing integrated marketing strategies and campaigns.

• Experience with digital marketing channels including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media.

• Proficiency with marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot.

• Experience with Microsoft 365 (Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint).

• Experience with website content management systems (CMS).

• Technical writing experience.

• Experience analyzing marketing performance using dashboards and reporting tools.

• Strong English communication skills.

Nice to Have

• Experience within Life Sciences, Diagnostics, Biotechnology, or Medical Technology.

• Experience supporting OEM/CDMO organizations.

• Training or certification in Account-Based Marketing, Branding, or Project Management.

• AI for Marketing experience.

• Marketing Analytics expertise.

• Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or SAP C4C.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted content creation tools.

• Customer journey mapping expertise.

• Additional language skills such as German.

• Creative thinking and innovation experience.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to travel approximately 20%.

Salary range: $100K– $125K
(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Unser Ziel.

Bei Tecan sind wir bestrebt, das Leben und die Gesundheit der Menschen zu verbessern. Bleib einzigartig und lass es zählen.

Wir fördern ein positives und ermächtigendes Umfeld, in dem unsere seltensten Vermögenswerte, unsere einzigartigen Mitarbeiter, wachsen und ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent einbringen können.

Faire un impact chez Tecan

Rejoignez Tecan en tant que directeur marketing, où vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le positionnement de l'offre CDMO de Tecan, grâce à des campagnes de marketing intégrées, un leadership de pensée et une collaboration étroite avec des équipes commerciales mondiales.

Dans ce rôle, vous servirez de partenaire marketing entre la gestion des produits, les ventes, le développement des affaires, les équipes commerciales régionales, la marque et les communications internes afin de renforcer l'engagement des clients, d'optimiser l'entonnoir de vente et de fournir des résultats commerciaux mesurables.

• Créer des cadres de messagerie, des propositions de valeur et un positionnement du marché alignés sur les objectifs opérationnels.

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des campagnes de marketing intégrées, y compris le marketing axé sur les comptes (ABM).

• Élaborer du matériel d'aide à la vente, y compris des présentations, des brochures, des études de cas, des trousses de campagne et des biens numériques.

• Diriger et soutenir des événements mondiaux, des événements clients, des webinaires et des conférences de l'industrie.

• Tenir à jour la bibliothèque de présentation des entreprises partenaires et coordonner les mises à jour avec les gestionnaires de produits.

Vos antécédents

• Expérience des canaux de marketing numérique incluant le référencement, le SEM, le marketing par courriel et les médias sociaux.

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en donnant à nos clients les moyens d'étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow?

Tecan is a pioneer and a globally leading company in laboratory automation and a healthcare enabler. The company is improving people’s lives and health by empowering customers to scale healthcare innovation globally. Tecan enables customers to scale their innovation, whether in laboratory workflows for life science research, various applied markets and diagnostics or in product development and manufacturing for the medical market. Tecan delivers this broad range of healthcare products and services directly to end users or with OEM partners.

Are you ready to drive strategic impact on a global scale? As our Strategic Pricing & Analytics Manager, you’ll be at the forefront of our transformation toward value-based pricing, shaping the way we define and measure commercial success. Join our Global Commercial Excellence team and become the champion for pricing innovation and commercial metrics—partnering with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product teams to embed best practices and ensure transparency across the organization. If you’re passionate about analytics, collaboration, and making a difference, this is your opportunity to lead change and elevate our commercial performance worldwide!

Manager Strategic Pricing & Analytics 100%

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution
Join our Global Commercial Excellence team as a Strategic Pricing & Analytics Manager! In this pivotal role you will:

• Drive with the design, deployment, and continuous improvement of value-based pricing approaches across products, markets, and customer segments.
• Support new product development and launches with pricing analyses, price recommendations, and business case assessments
• Partner with Finance and Commercial teams to define a new global pricing policy and governance
• Build analytical models and methodologies to support value-based price setting, price differentiation, and price positioning
• Define and standardize metrics, with focus on pricing, such as price realization, discount rate, deal margin, and value capture indicators
• Design and maintain pricing analytics dashboards, tools, and reporting that enable pricing execution and monitoring
• Drive and own the global annual price adjustments process and coordinate its implementation

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work. The position requires the following:

Hard / Technical Skills
• BA / MBA preferably in STEM
• Min 5 years of experience in pricing management and commercial analytics
• Strong understanding of pricing and commercial metrics
• Understanding of value-based pricing principles and value capture mechanisms in B2B environments
• Demonstrated experience designing dashboards and reports that support pricing and commercial decisions (e.g., in PowerBI or Tableau)
• Ability to build and interpret pricing models, scenario analyses, and what-if simulations
• Proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel (advanced), SQL, Python/R, or BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
• Excellent level of English – any additional languages are of added value
• Passion for life sciences / healthcare topics

Soft Skills
• Ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders across all levels
• Strong team player with strong oral & written communication skills
• Proactive & takes initiative to get things done
• Can-do mindset
• Well organized and able to structure fast moving projects
• Takes accountability for own work and is firmly focused on results
• Eager to learn, explore new ideas & opportunities on a day-to-day basis

What makes working at Tecan unique
• You can expect a collegial and supportive team culture built on openness and trust.
• The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow
• Working in an international and diverse environment
• The opportunity to grow your career in a company that values both legal excellence and business impact.
• Feel empowered by our strong and unique Tecan culture
• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work.

We look forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (without picture and without cover letter; reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Only applications that fully meet our requirements will be considered.

Spécialiste de la paie

Lieu : Morgan Hill, CA 95037 ou Morrisville, NC 27560

Résumé du poste

Le spécialiste des états de paie est responsable du traitement exact et en temps opportun des états de paie multi-états tout en veillant au respect de tous les règlements fédéraux, des États et locaux applicables en matière de paie. Ce rôle sert de ressource clé pour l'administration de la paye, l'observation de l'impôt sur la paie, la vérification, la production de rapports et le soutien de la paye des employés. Le spécialiste de la paie collabore étroitement avec les Ressources humaines, la comptabilité et d'autres ministères pour maintenir l'intégrité des données sur la paye, résoudre les problèmes liés à la paye et appuyer l'amélioration continue des processus.

Fonctions et responsabilités essentielles

Administration de la paie

• Traiter la paye bihebdomadaire pour les employés de plusieurs États, en assurant l'exactitude, l'exhaustivité et la conformité aux politiques de l'entreprise et aux exigences réglementaires.

• Examiner et valider les feuilles de temps des employés, les taux de rémunération, le calcul des heures supplémentaires, les avantages sociaux et les retenues sur la paie.

• Traiter et réconcilier les charges à payer, y compris les impôts, les saisie-arrêts, les cotisations de retraite et les retenues sur la LSH/LSF.

• Assurer le versement en temps opportun des paiements liés à la paye et tenir à jour les documents justificatifs pour toutes les déclarations et opérations.

• Tenir des registres de paie et des documents conformément aux politiques de l'entreprise et aux exigences légales.

Conformité à la paie

• Veiller au respect des règlements fédéraux, des États et locaux en matière d'impôt sur les salaires, des lois sur les salaires et les heures de travail et des exigences en matière de rapports.

• Aider à l'enregistrement de l'impôt sur la paie et à la tenue des comptes dans les nouveaux états opérationnels.

• Surveiller les changements réglementaires et recommander des mises à jour des processus de paye au besoin.

Administration des systèmes

• Maintenir l'intégrité et l'exactitude des données du système de paye au sein de l'effectif d'ADP maintenant.

• Dépanner les problèmes du système de paye et coordonner les résolutions avec les intervenants internes et les fournisseurs externes.

• Appuyer les mises à jour, les essais et la mise en oeuvre des améliorations apportées au système de paye.

Audit et rapports

• Aider les vérificateurs internes et externes des états de paie et fournir la documentation nécessaire.

• Réconcilier les comptes de paie et appuyer les activités du grand livre général liées à la paie.

• S'associer à la comptabilité pour assurer l'exactitude des allocations de main-d'oeuvre et des rapports sur les coûts d'emploi.

• Générer des rapports de paie récurrents et ponctuels pour la direction et les partenaires commerciaux.

Soutien des employés et résolution des problèmes

• Répondre aux demandes de renseignements sur la paye des employés et résoudre les écarts de paye en temps opportun et de façon professionnelle.

• Recherche et correction des erreurs de paye tout en assurant la documentation et la communication appropriées.

Collaboration interfonctionnelle

• S'associer aux ressources humaines pour les activités liées à la paye, y compris les nouveaux employés, les changements de statut de l'employé, les licenciements, les congés et l'administration des avantages sociaux.

• Vérifier l'exactitude des données sur la paye et maintenir l'alignement entre les systèmes de RH et de paye.

• Collaborer avec les équipes des finances et de la comptabilité pour appuyer les exigences en matière de rapports sur la paie et de conformité.

Amélioration des processus

• Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer les processus de paye, les contrôles et l'efficacité.

• Analyser les données sur la paie afin de cerner les tendances, les écarts et les risques de conformité.

• Recommander et mettre en oeuvre des pratiques exemplaires pour améliorer l'exactitude, l'efficacité et l'expérience des employés.

Activités de fin d'année et trimestrielles

• Aider aux processus de paye trimestriels et annuels, y compris la déclaration de l'impôt sur la paie, les rapprochements et les déclarations.

• Appuyer les activités de fin d'année, y compris l'examen, la validation, la distribution et les exigences connexes en matière de rapports.

Compétences

Requis

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le traitement des états de paie, y compris l'administration des états de paie.

• Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience pratique avec ADP Workforce Now.

• Connaissance approfondie des lois et règlements sur la paie, y compris la retenue d'impôt, les exigences en matière de salaire et d'heure, les saisie-arrêts et le respect de la paie.

• Compétence avancée en Microsoft Excel et outils de rapports de paie.

• Fortes compétences en analyse, en organisation et en résolution de problèmes.

• Excellente attention aux détails avec un haut degré de précision et de confidentialité.

• Fortes compétences en relations interpersonnelles et en communication avec la capacité de travailler efficacement dans tous les ministères.

Préféré

• Désignation d'un professionnel certifié de la paye (PPC).

• Expérience des fonctions de comptabilité de la paie et rapprochements du grand livre général.

• Connaissance des coûts des emplois et des processus d'allocation de la main-d'oeuvre.

Échelle salariale : 65K$– 85K$
(Le salaire doit être déterminé par l'éducation, l'expérience, les connaissances, les compétences et les capacités du demandeur, l'équité interne et l'harmonisation avec les données de l'industrie.)

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en responsabilisant nos clients à étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. descriptionByLocale.en:
Supply Chain Engineering Manager

Onsite – Morgan Hill, CA

Full-Time | Exempt

Make an Impact at Tecan

Are you passionate about solving complex supply chain challenges and building strong partnerships with suppliers and customers? Join Tecan as a Supply Chain Engineering Manager, where you'll play a critical role in supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), driving supplier performance, and ensuring manufacturing readiness from product launch through full-scale production.

In this role, you'll serve as the technical bridge between customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams, leading engineering initiatives that improve quality, reduce cost, mitigate supply chain risk, and enable successful product commercialization. You'll collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Program Management, Planning, and Purchasing to deliver innovative solutions that support business growth and customer success.

If you're a technically driven problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys influencing cross-functional teams, and is passionate about continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Lead engineering activities supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) and sustaining production by identifying and resolving mechanical and manufacturing challenges.

• Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Program Management, Planning, and Purchasing to support production and product lifecycle objectives.

• Serve as the primary technical liaison between Tecan, customers, and suppliers to identify and resolve Design for Manufacturing (DFM) opportunities.

• Manage assigned commodities including machined components, sheet metal, mechanical assemblies, plastics, cable assemblies, printed circuit boards (PCBs), and related suppliers.

• Develop and execute commodity strategies that improve supplier performance, quality, delivery, and total cost.

• Identify and implement cost reduction initiatives that deliver measurable value while maintaining quality and supply continuity.

• Evaluate, qualify, and recommend suppliers during quoting, NPI, production transfers, and manufacturing scale-up activities.

• Support supplier transitions, tooling implementation, First Article Inspection (FAI), and production readiness for new programs.

• Provide technical expertise for supplier selection, manufacturing process improvements, tooling development, and strategic engineering projects.

• Resolve supplier-related issues impacting production, including quality concerns, material shortages, delivery delays, and manufacturing constraints.

• Identify supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies that protect production schedules and revenue objectives.

• Evaluate supplier business proposals and recommend solutions that improve cost, quality, delivery, and overall business performance.

• Support supplier qualification activities and ensure compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.

• Build collaborative relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders through effective communication and technical leadership.

• Influence cross-functional teams to achieve project milestones and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Travel periodically to supplier and customer locations to support technical reviews, supplier development, and manufacturing readiness activities.

What You Bring

• Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles.

• Proven supplier development, supplier management, and technical problem-solving experience.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

• Ability to think strategically while executing day-to-day operational priorities.

• Strong verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Self-motivated with exceptional project management and execution skills.

• Collaborative mindset with a focus on delivering customer-focused solutions.

• Adaptability and resilience in rapidly changing business environments.

Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Four or more years of experience in Supply Chain Engineering, Supplier Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical engineering role.

• Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) and manufacturing environments.

• Experience working directly with suppliers, customers, and cross-functional engineering teams.

• Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Microsoft Office applications.

• Experience supporting supplier qualification, manufacturing transfers, and production scale-up activities.

• Experience managing technical supplier relationships and commodity strategies is preferred.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in customer-facing environments.

• Experience working within multinational organizations is a plus.

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting medical device or highly regulated manufacturing environments.

• Experience with global supplier development and international manufacturing.

• Knowledge of supplier quality systems, APQP, PPAP, FAI, and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Experience leading cost reduction and value engineering initiatives.

• Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles.

• Experience supporting offshore manufacturing transfers and tooling development.

• Professional certifications in Supply Chain, Quality, or Project Management.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, including local, domestic, and international travel.

What We Offer

• Medical, Dental, and Vision effective on your first day

• 16 company-paid holidays

• 401(k) employer match on first 6% contributions (no vesting period)

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• HSA & HRA options

• Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity coverage

• Legal Shield / Identity Shield

• Discounted Pet Insurance

Salary Range: $120K-150K

Salary will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

En tirant parti de vos compétences analytiques et de votre passion pour l’optimisation des processus, vous contribuerez directement au succès et à l’innovation continus des opérations de consommables de Tecan. Mansioni - Soutenir et représenter les consommables dans les initiatives SAP (par exemple, SAP IBP, S/4HANA). - Collaborer avec l'équipe mondiale des consommables et les parties prenantes pour identifier et prioriser les besoins en matière d'analyse. - Développer et fournir des analyses exploitables, garantissant la qualité et la pertinence des données. - Évaluer et recommander des améliorations pour les processus de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. - Préparer et soutenir les activités de reporting et les présentations. - Automatisez les rapports et les processus d'analyse récurrents pour améliorer l'efficacité. - Fournir une analyse ad hoc et un soutien aux parties prenantes, selon les besoins. - Documenter les processus d'analyse et conserver des enregistrements clairs pour l'utilisation de l'équipe.
• Requisiti - Nous ne recherchons pas seulement des compétences techniques : nous recherchons des personnes qui mettent leur passion et leur talent au travail. - Formation technique ou commerciale avec une formation avancée en supply chain ou en achats. - 2+ ans d'expérience en chaîne d'approvisionnement ou en gestion des matériaux. - Maîtrise de SAP R/3, S/4HANA, IBP et Business Warehouse. - Compétences avancées en Excel et PowerPoint. - Expérience avec Power BI (agréable à avoir). - Bonne expérience pratique dans l'application des outils et technologies d'IA (agréable à avoir). - Expérience en moulage par injection (un atout). - Fortes capacités d'analyse, de communication et de gestion des parties prenantes. - Indépendant, assertif et discipliné avec les données. - Maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais, tant écrits qu'oraux. - Axé sur le client, collaboratif, flexible et orienté solution. Cosa ofriamo - La chance de faire en sorte que cela compte et d'avoir un impact sur le monde de demain. - Travailler dans un environnement international et diversifié. - La chance de développer votre carrière au sein de l'entreprise. - Sentez-vous responsabilisé par notre culture d'entreprise forte et unique. - Une rémunération et des avantages sociaux complets. Contatto - Rejoignez Tecan, un endroit où il fait bon travailler ! Découvrez notre récente certification Great Place to Work. - Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne. Veuillez soumettre votre CV (sans photo et sans lettre de motivation, les lettres de référence et les diplômes sont facultatifs).

Site Manager & Head Operations (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In questa difficile posizione di leadership, sei responsabile della gestione professionale e del personale dell'area Operazioni. Garantisci la produzione e la consegna di attrezzature e attrezzature di alta qualità, tempestiva e conveniente. In qualità di Responsabile del Sito, si assume la responsabilità generale per la sicurezza del lavoro, la salute e la protezione ambientale, nonché la gestione delle strutture nelle nostre sedi a Männedorf e Nänikon. Definire e controllare gli obiettivi per la produzione, l'acquisto, la pianificazione e la spedizione

Costruzione e leadership di un “migliore nel settore” Squadra operativa

Introduzione e sviluppo di processi di miglioramento continuo (CDP)

Garantire il rispetto di leggi, norme e requisiti interni (ISO 9001, ISO 13485, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, MDSAP)

Responsabilità per la pianificazione del bilancio e delle risorse nelle operazioni e nella gestione delle strutture

Il tuo profilo

Non siamo solo alla ricerca di competenze: stiamo cercando persone che traducono la loro passione e talento con noi.

Formazione di base tecnica superiore (FH o paragonabile), ideale con lo sfondo di ingegneria

Affari e/o produzione/logistica ulteriore istruzione

Esperienza pluriennale nell'industria e nella leadership

Conoscenza della produzione, gestione dei materiali, acquisto e logistica

Conoscenza molto buona di tedesco e inglese, altre lingue di vantaggio

Il pensiero imprenditoriale, le elevate qualità di leadership e lo spirito di squadra

Capacità di carico e capacità di esecuzione

Cosa rende il lavoro unico a Tecan?

La possibilità di fare qualcosa e di plasmare il mondo di domani

Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

Eccitanti opportunità di carriera

Cultura aziendale forte e unica

Retribuzione attraente e prestazioni sociali

Diventa parte di Tecan, certificato come Grande Luogo di Lavoro! Qui potete saperne di più sulla nostra certificazione. Ottimo posto per lavorare.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per la vostra applicazione abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV (senza foto e senza lettera di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Possiamo solo tenere conto delle applicazioni che
• soddisfare i requisiti.

#lifescience # healthc are #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #management #EHS #facilitymanagement #leadership #engineering

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - fiducia, standard più elevati e ambiziosi - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. promuovere un ambiente positivo e potenziante in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

Ti sei mai chiesto come le tue abilità e il tuo background unico potrebbero influenzare il mondo di domani?

Tecan è un pioniere e un'azienda leader a livello mondiale nell'automazione di laboratorio e in un abilitatore sanitario. L'azienda sta migliorando la vita e la salute delle persone, consentendo ai clienti di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale. Tecan consente ai clienti di scalare la loro innovazione, sia nei flussi di lavoro di laboratorio per la ricerca sulla scienza della vita, vari mercati applicati e diagnostica o nello sviluppo del prodotto e nella produzione per il mercato medico. Tecan offre questa vasta gamma di prodotti e servizi sanitari direttamente agli utenti finali o ai partner OEM.

Unisciti al nostro Global Sales Operations Team e modella la tua carriera in una fase globale.

Gestione delle operazioni di vendita IVD & LS Partnering (80- 100%)

Männedorf, Svizzera

Il tuo contributo

In qualità di Manager Sales Operations IVD & LS Partnering sarai responsabile delle operazioni di vendita post-appalto compilando e analizzando i rapporti di vendita, coordinando i prezzi e la logistica e garantendo una gestione accurata dei dati nei sistemi SAP e CRM. Fornisce anche formazione utente, risoluzione dei problemi e collabora con i team interni per mantenere efficienti processi di vendita e reporting.

Lo farai:

Compili, analizza e segnala i dati di vendita, budget e previsioni utilizzando i sistemi SAP e CRM.

Coordinare le operazioni di vendita post-contrattuali, compresi gli aggiustamenti dei prezzi, la creazione di preventivi e la revisione logistica.

Supporto e formazione degli utenti sugli strumenti SAP e CRM, assicurando una gestione accurata dei dati e problemi di risoluzione dei problemi.

Collabora con i team interni per mantenere processi di vendita efficienti e partecipare a progetti di miglioramento del sistema.

Agire come helpdesk di prima linea per gli utenti CRM e gestire i canali di comunicazione per le operazioni di vendita.

Monitorare e verificare le allocazioni di vendita e l'implementazione del contratto, avviare azioni correttive secondo le necessità.

Partecipa a chiamate commerciali e incontri con i clienti, sostenendo il team di vendita su vari argomenti commerciali.

Il tuo sfondo

Non stiamo solo cercando competenze difficili: Stiamo cercando persone che portano la loro passione e talento al lavoro. Accogliamo i professionisti con esperienza pratica che sono desiderosi di costruire la loro carriera nelle operazioni di vendita globali. Tu porti:

Esperienza minima di 5 anni nelle operazioni di analisi delle vendite o vendite, utilizzando attivamente applicazioni aziendali CRM e SAP.

Competenze avanzate di MS Excel (comprese le formule, le macro e la programmazione) e la competenza in MS Office.

L'esperienza di lavoro in ambienti internazionali e come membro del team di progetto è una risorsa.

Ottimo inglese richiesto; tedesco e altre lingue sono un plus.

Forte comunicazione, lavoro di squadra, orientamento di processo, focus del cliente e capacità di problem solving, con la capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e interagire efficacemente con i leader senior.

Cappello W fa lavorare a Tecan unico

Ci si può aspettare una collegiale e solidale cultura di squadra costruita su apertura e fiducia.

La possibilità di farlo contare e di avere un impatto sul mondo di domani

Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

L'opportunità di crescere la tua carriera in un'azienda che valorizza sia l'eccellenza legale che l'impatto aziendale

Sentirsi potenziato dalla nostra cultura Tecan forte e unica

Pacchetto completo di compensazione e benefici

Unisciti a Tecan, un ottimo posto per lavorare! Leggi la nostra recente certificazione da Great Place a Work .

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di inviare il CV o il curriculum (senza immagine e senza lettera di copertura; lettere di riferimento e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Saranno considerate solo le applicazioni che soddisfano pienamente i nostri requisiti.

#lifescience #healthcare # SalesOperations #CRMJobs #SalesSupport#Teamwork

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow?

  

 Tecan is a pioneer and a globally leading company in laboratory automation and a healthcare enabler. The company is improving people’s lives and health by empowering customers to scale healthcare innovation globally. Tecan enables customers to scale their innovation, whether in laboratory workflows for life science research, various applied markets and diagnostics or in product development and manufacturing for the medical market. Tecan delivers this broad range of healthcare products and services directly to end users or with OEM partners.

  

 Join our Global Sales Operations Team and shape your career on a global stage.

  

 Manager Sales Operations IVD & LS Partnering (80- 100%)

  

 Männedorf, Switzerland

  

 Your contribution

 As Manager Sales Operations IVD & LS Partnering you will be responsible for post-contract sales operations by compiling and analyzing sales reports, coordinating pricing and logistics, and ensuring accurate data management in SAP and CRM systems. It also provides user training, troubleshooting, and collaborates with internal teams to maintain efficient sales processes and reporting.

  

 You will:

 Compile, analyze, and report sales data, budgets, and forecasts using SAP and CRM systems.

 Coordinate post-contract sales operations, including price adjustments, quote creation, and logistics review.

 Support and train users on SAP and CRM tools, ensuring accurate data management and troubleshooting issues.

 Collaborate with internal teams to maintain efficient sales processes and participate in system enhancement projects.

 Act as a first-line helpdesk for CRM users and manage communication channels for sales operations.

 Monitor and verify sales allocations and contract implementation, initiating corrective actions as needed.

 Participate in commercial calls and meetings with customers, supporting the sales team on various commercial topics.

  

  

  

 Your background

 We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work. We welcome professionals with practical experience who are eager to build their career in global Sales Operations. You bring:

  

 Minimum 5 years’ experience in sales analytics or sales operations, actively using CRM and SAP business applications.

 Advanced MS Excel skills (including formulas, macros, and programming) and proficiency in MS Office.

 Experience working in international environments and as a project team member is an asset.

 Excellent English required; German and other languages are a plus.

 Strong communication, teamwork, process orientation, customer focus, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work under pressure and interact effectively with senior leaders.

  

 W hat makes working at Tecan unique

 You can expect a collegial and supportive team culture built on openness and trust.

 The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

 Working in an international and diverse environment

 The opportunity to grow your career in a company that values both legal excellence and business impact

 Feel empowered by our strong and unique Tecan culture

 Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

  

  

  

 Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

  

 We look forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (without picture and without cover letter; reference letters and diplomas are optional).

  

 Only applications that fully meet our requirements will be considered.

  

 #lifescience #healthcare # SalesOperations#CRMJobs #SalesSupport#Teamwork

 Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

 Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.
